players.detail: Kalkbrenner (hip) is probable for Saturday's matchup with Brooklyn.

players.name: Kon Knueppel
players.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

players.name: Norman Powell
players.detail: Powell (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pacers.

players.name: Caleb Wilson
players.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jalen Smith
players.detail: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.

players.name: Noa Essengue
players.detail: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.

players.name: Steven Adams
players.detail: Adams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Tyrese Haliburton
players.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out per Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.

players.name: T.J. McConnell
players.detail: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

players.name: Ben Sheppard
players.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
players.detail: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

players.name: Jalen Williams
players.detail: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

players.name: Chet Holmgren
players.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

players.name: Aday Mara
players.detail: Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks, per Clemente Almanza of USA Today.

players.name: Cason Wallace
players.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Jaylin Williams
players.detail: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

players.name: Nikola Topic
players.detail: Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

players.name: Thomas Sorber
players.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

players.name: Paolo Banchero
players.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
players.detail: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

players.name: Anthony Black
players.detail: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

players.name: Colin Castleton
players.detail: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

players.name: Noah Penda
players.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jonathan Isaac
players.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

players.name: Izaiyah Nelson
players.detail: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jaylen Brown
players.detail: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.

players.name: Dean Wade
players.detail: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.

players.name: Ariel Hukporti
players.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Tristan Vukcevic
players.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

players.name: Jamir Watkins
players.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

players.name: Justin Champagnie
players.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

players.name: Reece Beekman
players.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
